chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from a man who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The ones with hearts to be reconciled have never been more numerous than they are today; and they are a people who affirmed the Oneness of Allah and exited from polytheism, but the recognition of Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and what he brought did not enter their hearts. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was kind to them, and the believers were kind to them after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so that they might recognize (the truth).'

key_terms.التَّأْلِيف: Reconciliation or winning over hearts through kindness/generosity
key_terms.الشِّرْكِ: Polytheism or associating partners with God
key_terms.الْمُؤَلَّفَةُ قُلُوبُهُمْ: Those whose hearts are to be reconciled (a specific group in Islamic jurisprudence and history)
key_terms.مَعْرِفَة: Recognition or deep knowledge (of the Prophet and his message)

ai.seo_question: Who are the Mu'allafah Qulubum and why did the Prophet show them kindness?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (as) clarifies that the 'Mu'allafah Qulubuhum' were primarily new converts from polytheism who had accepted monotheism but lacked deep theological conviction regarding Prophethood. This narration highlights the strategic wisdom of the Prophet and the Imams in using material generosity as a means to facilitate intellectual and spiritual acceptance, ensuring their hearts were softened for the deeper truth of Islam.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from a man who said,

‘Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘The ones of distorted hearts have never been more than what they are today; and they are a people who are professing to the Oneness of Allahazwj are exiting from the Shirk (Polytheism), but did not enter the recognition of Muhammadsaww as Rasool-Allahsaww into their hearts and whatever hesaww came with. So, Rasool-Allahsaww was kind to them, and the Momineen were kind to them after Rasool-Allahsaww, perhaps they would recognise’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr from a man who has said the following: “

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘People of inclined hearts had never been as many as they are today. They were a people who accepted Allah only, had come out of paganism but the true knowledge about Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah had not entered their hearts as well as certain issues of what he had brought from Allah. The Messenger of Allah would meet them with kindness and after the Messenger of Allah the believers would meet them with kindness so they might receive true knowledge.’”
